files.config:
# global
Include conf.d/*.conf
Compression yes

Host web
    HostName 10.0.0.5
    Port 2222
    User = deploy
    IdentityFile @TMP@/ssh/missing_key
    IdentityFile @TMP@/ssh/id_work
    LocalForward 8080 localhost:80
    LocalForward 5433 db.internal:5432
    DynamicForward 1080
    ForwardAgent yes
    ProxyCommand ssh -W %h:%p bastion
    ControlMaster auto
    Ciphers aes256-gcm@openssh.com

Host db-*  !db-test
    User dba

Host db-prod
    HostName "db.prod.example"
    ProxyJump bastion,jump2
    StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new

Host db-test
    HostName db.test.example

Match host *.example exec "false"
    User nobody

Host *
    User fallback
    ServerAliveInterval 30
files.conf.d/10-lab.conf:
Host lab1 lab2
    HostName %h.lab.example
    User testadmin
